data.description:
## Description

**What**: At epic close: remove the parity-test CI job (and its entry from `.github/required-checks.txt`); remove the deprecated `llm-api-call.sh` compat wrapper (if added in S6) after one minor-version deprecation window with consumer-re-enumeration verification; finalize the CI duration delta report (post-migration vs. S1 pre-migration baseline) in the close artifact.

**Why**: SC3 ("parity-test job is removed at epic close") and SC5 ("CI run duration neutral-or-better") closure requirements. Each requires an explicit removal / report step that ties the epic closure to a verifiable artifact and prevents stale references (required-checks.txt entry; compat wrapper) from blocking future PRs.

**Scope**:
- IN: Remove parity-test CI job; remove parity-test entry from `.github/required-checks.txt` and run `validate-required-checks.sh` to confirm alignment; re-enumerate in-tree consumers of llm-api-call.sh compat wrapper (or grep) to confirm zero references; verify out-of-tree deprecation note was published one minor version prior; remove compat wrapper if all checks pass; produce CI duration delta report (post-migration p50/p95 from S5 vs. pre-migration p50/p95 from S1) in the epic close artifact and assert SC5 "neutral-or-better."
- OUT: Capturing duration baselines (S1 + S5); writing the parity test (S4); writing docs / deprecation notes (S6); closing the epic ticket itself (handled by sprint workflow).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the parity-test CI job has been removed from the repo, AND its check name has been removed from `.github/required-checks.txt`, AND `validate-required-checks.sh` confirms alignment (no dangling required check).
  ← Satisfies: "Parity-test job runs in CI for the duration of the epic and is removed at epic close"
- When this story is complete, the deprecated `llm-api-call.sh` compat wrapper (if added in S6) has been removed, gated by: (a) re-running the consumer enumeration from S2.5 (or equivalent grep) confirming zero in-tree references, AND (b) verifying the release-notes deprecation note was published in the prior minor version.
  ← Satisfies: SC1 (deletion safety) at end-of-window
- When this story is complete, post-migration p50 and p95 CI review-job duration on the fixture corpus has been compared to S1's pre-migration baseline, the delta is reported in the epic close artifact, and the assertion "post-migration p50/p95 ≤ pre-migration p50/p95" passes.
  ← Satisfies: "CI run duration neutral-or-better: post-migration p50 and p95 CI review-job duration on the fixture corpus is no greater than the bash-baseline duration"

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Removing a required-check entry without removing the corresponding workflow job (or vice versa) leaves either dangling required-check names (blocking all PRs) or unenforced parity (silent drift). Both must be removed atomically.
- [Reliability] Compat wrapper removal must verify zero remaining consumers — a dangling caller in any in-tree script breaks CI silently on first invocation post-removal.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, epic close removes the parity-test job and required-check, removes the deprecated compat wrapper, and reports the CI duration delta
